From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba activation link rejected — can't see PO 45321

Quick diagnostic notes (internal):

- Observed failure: Ariba returned 'identity-link mismatch' during SAML/OIDC handoff. Logs show the invite token's "iss" and "aud" fields are correct, but the signed token's "exp" was generated from server time in UTC while the invite pre-signing pipeline applied a local TZ offset when computing the link expiry. On ZenOptics side the browser validated with a different offset (their browser and Ariba are interpreting the token TTL differently) which made the link effectively expired on acceptance.

- Secondary symptom: user account created in a sibling tenant (tenant alias collision) because the email normalization routine saw a subaddressing form (elena+procure@zenoptics.com) and mapped it to the wrong tenant. That explains PO invisibility even after successful registration.

Planned remediation:
1) Recreate an activation link with TTL explicitly stamped in UTC and include a tenant-id param that bypasses alias normalization for this invite.
2) Manually rebind the newly-created user (if any) to the correct tenant and attach PO 45321 to their account.
3) Roll a short fix to the invite generator to stop applying local TZ offsets when constructing expiry (will be in next patch).

I'll generate the admin preview link and the backfill script. Jordan, can you run the manual bind once I post the preview?

Rishi
Senior SRE, Integrations
Redwood Inference
